WidgetChip.description: A header chip and whether it is the one in force.

description:
What the pane paints for the active tab, built from the same scene the
window draws.

empty.description: What the pane says instead of data, when it has none.

market.description: The active tab's market, as the header names it.

open.description: Whether its window is on screen now.

provided.description:
Whether the active tab's feed provides what the pane shows; when
false the pane says so instead of drawing data.

rows.description: Data rows laid out: ladder rows, prints, liquidations or points.

texts.description: Every text item in paint order, at most [`MAX_READ_TEXTS`].
